the_arc_position.$comment: Stated plainly, because six missions have now ended here.
the_arc_position.target: two apparatuses whose independent measurements can reach one Claim, so the aggregator stops being algebraically identical to the B-2 pass-through baseline
the_arc_position.distance_from_it: two qualified apparatuses short of two
the_arc_position.what_has_actually_been_achieved: Four candidates have complete packages and each fails somewhere different and for a documented reason. That is not qualification, and it is not nothing: Mission 1.60's three candidates all failed at documentation retrieval, which said nothing about any of them.
what_would_move_it: a reviewed first-party answer to the three sent ONYPHE questions, which is asked and outstanding
the Netlas contact address, which is one string an operator can read off a page
a fifth candidate apparatus, which is Mission 1.67
the_arc_position.what_would_not_move_it: More public documentation about the four current candidates. This mission spent a full budget establishing that, for ONYPHE, the remaining facts are not published.

measurement_construct_unchanged.$comment: §3. Frozen, and not narrowed to fit a candidate.
